name: Send daily AI market briefings to email and Discord using AlphaAI and GPT

parameters.content:
## ☀️ AI Morning Market Briefing (AlphaAI + your AI model)

Every weekday before the open this workflow builds a personal market brief for **your watchlist** and emails it to you. If anything urgent shows up — bearish high-relevance news or a notable insider filing in the last 24h — it also pings a Discord channel immediately.

**What goes into the brief** (all from [AlphaAI](https://alphai.io) — enriched financial news: validated tickers, category, 1–10 relevance score and per-ticker sentiment out of the box, so there is no scraping / GPT-classification sub-flow here):
- per-ticker news from the last day, relevance-scored
- a 7-day sentiment tally per ticker (bullish / neutral / bearish coverage)
- a 30-day SEC **Form 4 insider** summary per ticker — who bought, who sold, for how much
- market-wide trending stories

Deterministic code decides the **red flags**; your own AI model only writes the narrative — it cannot invent alerts.

### Setup (~5 min)
1. **AlphaAI key** — free at [alphai.io/account/api-keys](https://alphai.io/account/api-keys?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=template&utm_campaign=morning_briefing). On all four AlphaAI nodes: Authentication → *Generic Credential Type → Bearer Auth*, one shared credential, paste the key `ak_live_…` (no `Bearer` prefix).
2. **OpenAI key** — on the *OpenAI Chat Model* node (or swap it for Anthropic/Gemini/any chat model — the chain doesn't care).
3. **SMTP** — on *Email the brief*, plus your from/to addresses.
4. *(Optional)* **Discord webhook** for urgent alerts: Channel → Edit → Integrations → Webhooks → copy URL into *Urgent ping (Discord)*. No webhook? Just delete that branch.
5. Put your tickers into **Watchlist & settings** and activate.

**Free tier fits:** up to 6 tickers = at most 19 AlphaAI calls per run (limit: 20/min, 100/day). Bigger watchlist → Basic ($2.99/mo, 60/min).

### 1 · Your watchlist
Comma-separated tickers (US equities, crypto as `BTC-USD`, foreign as `VOD.L`).

`min_relevance` — article floor for the digest (6 = solid default).
`urgent_min_score` — bearish news at or above this score becomes a red flag.

### 2 · Fetch enriched data — 4 AlphaAI endpoints
- `GET /api/news/?symbol=…` — last-day news per ticker, pre-scored
- `GET /api/symbols/{t}/sentiment-summary/` — 7-day sentiment tally
- `GET /api/symbols/{t}/insider-summary/` — 30-day SEC Form 4 rollup
- `GET /api/news/trending/` — market-wide top stories

One shared Bearer credential. Failures don't kill the run (nodes continue on error; the assembler tolerates gaps).

### 3 · AI writes, code decides
*Assemble briefing data* zips the four branches into one JSON payload and derives **red flags deterministically** (bearish score ≥ 8 news / notable insider filing, last 24h).

The LLM chain turns that payload into the briefing — structure and rules live in the prompt, edit freely. Swap the model node for any chat model.

### 4 · Deliver
- **Email** — the full brief as clean HTML, subject flips to 🚩 when flags exist
- **Discord** — red flags only, posted immediately as red embed cards

Extend it: archive briefs to Google Sheets / Notion, send to Slack or Telegram instead — everything downstream of *Render email & alerts* is plain n8n.

parameters.text:
=You are a buy-side analyst writing a pre-open morning briefing for a private investor. Below is a JSON payload with (a) the investor's watchlist — per ticker: high-relevance news from roughly the last day (each with an AI relevance score 1-10 and per-ticker sentiment), a 7-day sentiment tally (bullish/neutral/bearish article counts) and a 30-day SEC Form 4 insider summary; (b) market-wide trending stories; (c) deterministic red flags (bearish score>=8 news or notable insider filings, last 24h).

Write the briefing in Markdown, under 600 words, in this exact structure:

# Morning Market Briefing — <date>
## TL;DR
Up to 3 bullets — only what changes decisions today.
## Red flags
Only if red_flags is non-empty: one bullet per flag — what happened and what to verify before the open. Omit the whole section when there are none.
## Your watchlist
One short block per ticker in `watchlist`: lead with the read (bullish/bearish/mixed and why), cite specifics — relevance scores, insider dollar values, sentiment tallies. If `quiet_tickers` is non-empty, end the section with exactly one line: "Quiet: <quiet_tickers joined with commas> — no significant coverage." If `quiet_tickers` is empty, write no Quiet line at all.
## Market pulse
2-4 trending stories that matter beyond the watchlist; one line each on why they matter, with the article link.

Rules: be specific and quantitative, no filler, no generic advice, no disclaimers. Never invent facts, numbers or tickers — mention ONLY tickers present in the payload. Whenever you reference an article, link it as a Markdown link whose anchor text is the article's title, like [Apple Intelligence Fails To Ignite Upgrade Activity](https://alphai.io/news/article/…) — a shortened title is fine, but NEVER use "here", "Read more" or similar as anchor text, and use each url exactly as given in the payload.
